shows: A small white castle-style bounce house with pointed turrets and gold star decals on a park lawn, beside a white soft-play set with a ball pit of pastel balls; an attendant sits next to it and palm trees stand behind.

A red, orange, yellow and green bounce house with cartoon clown graphics and a printed party banner ('hiep hiep hoera'), sitting on a lawn in front of suburban houses under a cloudy sky, with balls inside and a small safety-pictogram sticker on the front.
A large white inflatable jumping pillow (bounce dome) set into a grassy park, with one child jumping on it under a blue sky with big white clouds.
A smiling boy in a yellow T-shirt sliding down a wide inflatable slide striped purple, orange and green.
A big orange and blue inflatable slide with a green-runged climbing wall beside it; a girl in red climbs the wall while a boy crouches at the bottom of the slide, with water droplets in the air.
Inside a colourful bounce house (teal, purple, pink and yellow walls with an arched doorway), a boy bounces on a yellow hopper ball while an older boy stands beside him.
A tall tropical-themed inflatable water slide with two palm-tree towers, blue slide lanes and a green-and-yellow splash base, set up in a fenced backyard with kids playing on it.
A big submarine-themed inflatable water slide in orange, purple, green and blue with several slide lanes running into an inflatable pool, with kids playing in the water.
A boy sliding head-first down a light-blue slip-and-slide into an orange splash bumper on green grass, with water spraying over him.
A tall inflatable climbing tower, grey and yellow with pink handholds and a teal saucer-shaped top, against a clear blue sky, with a boy climbing it.
A giant teal inflatable caterpillar with pink antennae on a yellow and blue bounce floor in a large outdoor inflatable fun park; a boy crawls through it and pink and yellow inflatables are behind.
A white party tent with clear-window sidewalls and guy ropes on a green lawn beside trees, with a folding garden chair and small table in the foreground.
Two white pop-up canopy tents sheltering craft-market stalls on grass and cobblestones in front of a red brick barn.
A long white frame event marquee with arched-window sidewalls and some open panels, on a lawn under a blue sky with trees and a house behind.
A rectangular wooden farmhouse table set outdoors for an event with plates, folded blue napkins, glassware, lemons and yellow-and-white flowers, with more set tables behind in a wooded garden.
Round tables with white floor-length linens, gold charger plates and small flower centrepieces, surrounded by black folding chairs on a sunny patio with a tiered stone fountain and trees.
Rows of white padded folding chairs set out on a sunny green lawn, with more white chairs in the background.
Small white kids' tables with grey star- and animal-shaped kids' chairs in a bright indoor playroom with house-shaped play-kitchen units behind.
Close-up of fluffy pink cotton candy being spun onto a stick above the bowl of a cotton candy machine.
Inside a stainless-steel popcorn machine: the kettle hangs above two yellow popcorn cups and freshly popped popcorn on the cabinet floor.
A rainbow (blue, green and red) snow cone with a pink straw and red gummy topping in a teal cup on a wooden counter, with orange bar stools behind.
A giant four-in-a-row yard game with a turquoise grid, orange stand and pink and green discs on a pale stone patio, with giant black chess pieces at the edge.
Giant wooden tumbling blocks: a short tower stacked on a black metal fire-pit table, with toppled blocks on grey gravel in front of a wooden picket fence.
A cornhole board with a brown-and-white chevron design and an orange bean bag on it, lying on green artificial turf with a second bag beside it (cropped so the maker's logo is out of frame).
